Chapter 631: Chapter 45: Great Harvest (5200 words, please subscribe)_3

But Lin Yuan?

Did those special Ninth Rank Evolvers have such audacity?

“Right, I have something to tell you.” Xilan seemed to recall something and spoke up, “Duoke and some special Ninth Rank Evolvers from our human civilization instructed me to ask you, do we need to join forces and completely expel other different species from the Xuanhuang Secret Realm?”

As Xilan spoke, her tone carried a hint of emotion.

If it had been before, an ordinary Ninth Rank Evolver like herself would never have caught the eyes of those special Ninth Rank Evolvers of human civilization, let alone Duoke, who was once the strongest Ninth Rank Evolver during the era of human civilization.

But because of Lin Yuan, because she and the Galaxy Master were on good terms, Duoke personally contacted him and spoke in a friendly and equitable manner.

...

The thing Xilan regretted the least was taking the Galaxy Master to hide within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm for those two to three years to avoid being hunted by the Hunyi.

“Expel the different species from the Xuanhuang Secret Realm?” Lin Yuan fell into contemplation.

“No problem,” Lin Yuan nodded.

As a member of human civilization, inherently opposed to those hostile different species, Lin Yuan had no psychological burden in doing these tasks.

“But probably not in the recent years.”

Lin Yuan spoke.

His Taiyang Divine Spirit was fully focused on refining the Core of the Secret Realm and had no time for other matters.

“No problem.”

“Duoke and the others said that anything within the next twenty years would work,”

Xilan smiled, saying that the Xuanhuang Secret Realm would close in forty years, so starting the cleanse of those Ninth Rank different species within the next twenty years was almost enough time.

It wasn’t a difficult task for Ninth Rank powerhouses of human civilization and their allied races to join forces and locate the positions of those Ninth Rank different species.

They hadn’t done so before because it could easily provoke other Ninth Rank different species to unite, but now, with the Galaxy Master involved, the more those Ninth Rank different species united, the greater their losses would be.

…

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

The Core of the Secret Realm floated before him, already mostly refined.

“Now I…”

Lin Yuan, while refining, opened his eyes and felt his own state.

Although he had not completely refined the Core of the Secret Realm yet, Lin Yuan now possessed numerous privileges within the secret realm.

One such privilege was instant spatial movement.

In the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, all forms of instant spatial movement were suppressed; even Lin Yuan, a formidable Ninth Rank who had opened up more than two billion Spatial Layers, still had to travel by slow flight.

This was not because Lin Yuan’s spatial perception was lacking, but rather the rules dictated so.

Just as in the Main Universe, where the maximum flight speed could only reach the speed of light, any faster would require entering wormholes.

These are the world’s rules.

But now, as his control of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm gradually improved.

Many of the world imposed limitations had already disappeared, which was also a ‘privilege’ befitting the master of the Secret Realm.

…

The Virtual World.

Dozens of Ninth Rank Evolvers gathered.

These Ninth Rank Evolvers, possessing powerful auras, had all opened up at least ten million Spatial Layers.

“Do you think the Galaxy Master will agree to our plan?” one of the Ninth Rank Evolvers with ten million layers couldn’t help but ask.

Although the Galaxy Master was a Ninth Rank like them, the numerous Ninth Rank Evolvers present already treated Lin Yuan as a Tenth Rank powerhouse.

That kind of power to instantly eliminate special Ninth Rank beings, apart from a true Tenth Rank, who else could achieve it?

“Not sure.” Duoke shook his head slightly; he had asked Xilan to pass along their wish to join forces to oust other Ninth Rank different species, merely his own plan and not part of human civilization’s strategy.

Therefore, the Galaxy Master could agree, or not agree.

Swoosh.

Just at that moment.

In this personal space.

Xilan’s figure appeared.

“Brother Xilan, how did it go?”

“What did the Galaxy Master say?”

One after another, Evolvers of at least Ninth Rank Myriad Heavy Realm turned their gaze towards Xilan.

“This…” Xilan had never been the focus of so many powerful beings, and suddenly felt a bit of pressure. He paused, then said in a deep voice, “The Galaxy Master has agreed, but it will take a few years.”

“Agreed?”

“The Galaxy Master has agreed?”

“A few years, no problem at all.”

The many Ninth Rank Myriad Heavy Realm Evolvers breathed a sigh of relief. Although the age of the Galaxy Master was but a fraction of theirs, in the world of Evolvers, strength was supreme. The strength of the Galaxy Master had won the respect of all Evolvers.

“Just to make it clear in advance, if the Galaxy Master takes action, he must claim ninety percent of the harvests,” Xilan added.

Regarding the division of harvests, although Xilan had not discussed the details with Lin Yuan, he was not about to concede either.

“Ninety percent?”

“Alright.”

“It’s trivial, don’t say ninety percent, even ninety-five percent would work.”

The numerous Ninth Rank Evolvers had no objections; this task could not be accomplished without the Galaxy Master. Relying on them to clear the Ninth Rank Different Species from the Secret Realm? It would be a fool’s dream.

So, no matter what conditions the Galaxy Master stipulated, they would agree.

To eliminate the Ninth Rank Alien Race was mainly for their own reputation; as for the harvests? Those were of secondary importance.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan silently opened his eyes.

“”Mysterious Yellow Strike”… the first stage is pretty much refined…”

Lin Yuan raised his right hand; a hazy light flickered, and with a casual strike, he erupted with double the strength of his whole body.

The Xuanhuang Secret Skill “Mysterious Yellow Strike” is divided into four stages; refining the first stage allows one to casually burst with double strength, and refining the fourth stage allows bursting with five times the strength.

“It’s tremendously powerful.”

Lin Yuan continually operated the “Mysterious Yellow Strike”; the same strike, when driven by the Secret Technique “Mysterious Yellow Strike”, could burst forth with strength far beyond the limit. This complex and mysterious transformation mesmerized Lin Yuan.

…

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

The Taiyang Divine Spirit, who was refining the Core of the Secret Realm, also opened his eyes.

“”Mysterious Yellow Strike”…” As Lin Yuan refined, he also tried to master this Secret Technique.

Refining the Core of the Secret Realm was not particularly difficult, but it was time-consuming. Usually, Lin Yuan would do other things while refining.

Buzzing.

A terrifying aura vibrated on the surface of Lin Yuan’s body.

“Hmm?”

“Does the ‘Mysterious Yellow Strike’ actually enhance the refining of the Core of the Secret Realm?” Lin Yuan’s eyes lit up slightly.

…

Meanwhile.

Not far away.

The Six-Armed Silhouette was observing Lin Yuan.

When a yellow haze lit up around Lin Yuan’s body, a look of astonishment appeared on the face of the Six-Armed Silhouette: “The “Mysterious Yellow Strike”, this young man has already mastered the first stage of the “Mysterious Yellow Strike”?”

“How many years has it been? When did the protective Secret Techniques of my Mysterious Emperor Lineage become so simple to master?”

The Six-Armed Silhouette couldn’t believe it.
